title: Why log₂ fold change?
caption: A fold change is expression in condition B divided by expression in condition A. A doubling is 2 and a halving is 0.5, which are not symmetrical; on a log₂ scale they are +1 and −1, and 'no change' is 0. Volcano plots use this scale.
alt: A curve of log base 2 of the fold change: zero at a fold change of 1, plus 1 at 2, plus 2 at 4, minus 1 at one half and minus 2 at one quarter.
description: Fold change = expression in B ÷ expression in A.
Doubled: fold change 2, log₂ = +1.  Halved: fold change ½, log₂ = −1.
On the log₂ scale increases and decreases of the same size are symmetrical.

checks.name: a halving is −1: the same size as a doubling, opposite sign
